question: Should maintainers keep waiting for this uneditable conflicting fork PR to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the still-open hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The patch direction is useful and tied to a valid canonical bug, but automation cannot repair the fork in place or supply the contributor's missing real delivery proof.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that ports the fix to SourceDeliveryPlan, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the author to rebase, enable maintainer edits or push an update, and add redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Close after cleanup window
options.body: If maintainers decide not to wait, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a fresh fix path.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that ports the fix to SourceDeliveryPlan, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame places vincentkoc closest to the gateway hook and SourceDeliveryPlan surfaces this PR must rebase onto.
